title: Macro & Market Regimes
subtitle: Read growth, inflation, rates, liquidity and volatility from FRED and market data, classify the regime with stated rules, and size to it honestly.
what_you_learn: Read the yield curve with dates: every 2s10s and 3m10y inversion since 1976, the 6-to-24-month leads to recession, and the 2022-2024 inversion that has not been followed by one
Track inflation through CPI, PCE, breakevens and real yields, and see why the +2.62-point rise in the 10-year real yield, not the CPI print, explains SPY -18.2%, TLT -31.2% and GLD -0.8% in 2022
Gauge liquidity and credit from the Fed balance sheet, the reverse repo facility and high-yield spreads, and tell a credit event (2008, 2020) from a rates event (2022) and an equity shock (2025)
Measure volatility regimes from VIX levels, VIX/VIX3M term structure and realised vs implied volatility, including what SPY did in months that began with the VIX above 30
Test the 200-day SMA filter honestly on SPY (9.15% vs 10.88% a year, -22.1% vs -55.2% drawdown, 60 losing whipsaws) and measure how late every filter fired in 2008, 2020, 2022 and 2025
Build a two-indicator, four-state classifier, measure how each state treated SPY, TLT and GLD, and size to it with vol targeting and exposure caps, reporting where the policy lost to buy-and-hold
